title: Ack128 lacks assigned bitmap validation available in Ack
description:
## Location
- /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/fragment/wire.rs lines 720-772

## Problem
`Ack` has two parsing methods:
- `from_bytes()` - basic parsing
- `from_bytes_for(data, assigned)` - validates bitmap against assigned positions

`Ack128` only has `from_bytes()` without the validation variant. This means large-N configurations (N > 6) cannot validate that received ACK bitmaps only reference positions that were actually assigned.

## What Goes Wrong
A malicious or buggy sender could send an ACK with bitmap bits set for positions that were never assigned (never transmitted). Without validation, the receiver will process these as valid, potentially:
1. Incorrectly calculating missing fragments
2. Causing inconsistent state between sender and receiver
3. Allowing an attacker to manipulate reassembly state

## Suggested Fix
Add `from_bytes_for(data: &[u8], assigned: Option<u128>)` to Ack128 mirroring the Ack API.
